projects.title: Time-series foundation model
projects.summary: A decoder-only transformer pretrained from scratch in PyTorch, then scored zero-shot on datasets held out of training after overlapping benchmark series were removed.
projects.caveat: The headline CRPS is a validation result on 16 held-out configurations and one seed. The 80% intervals cover 65% of outcomes. The test split was not scored, and no comparison to published models is claimed.

projects.title: World Shock Lab
projects.summary: Event studies of Federal Reserve, Bank of Canada, and OPEC surprises across global assets, with a pre-registered test of whether machine learning adds anything, and a scenario tool published before each decision.
projects.caveat: On the original benchmark, a neural net did not beat the linear model across 168 held-out announcements (gap −0.003, 90% interval −0.019 to +0.014). A second pre-registered study, ml-study-v1, is on an open pull request and is not merged: quantile gradient boosting cut 5% pinball loss to 1.446 versus 1.558 for the Gaussian linear baseline (difference −0.112, 90% interval −0.228 to −0.010). The temporal CNN did not beat the linear model on the mean (+0.015, 90% interval −0.006 to +0.037). None of 80 regime tests survived false-discovery control.

image.alt: World Shock Lab scenario for a Federal Reserve hike and an oil supply cut, with bands around six Canadian assets.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Mission Control
projects.summary: A local multi-agent AI team: planner, worker, critic; tool use; QLoRA fine-tuning. Mission Control replays saved engine traces in the browser.
projects.caveat: Evaluation pending: single agent vs team vs fine-tuned team on a frozen test set. No language-model score is shown. Bundled replays are labeled scripted harness and are not model scores.

image.alt: Mission Control replay with planner, worker, and critic, a scripted harness label, and a tool module on the worker.

team.label: Team
team.source: Orbit README: a local planner, a worker, and a critic. The worker calls tools. The critic sends a bad claim back.

tools.label: Tools
tools.source: Orbit README: sandboxed Python, a calculator, corpus file read, a per-run file write, keyword retrieval, and an offline web cache. Nothing in the tool path opens a socket.

eval.label: Frozen-test evaluation
eval.source: Orbit README results table: single base model, team base model, team plus adapter, and the paired comparison are pending runs. No language-model score has been measured.

host.label: Where a live run goes
host.source: Orbit README: Mission Control replays a saved trace, and a task you start runs on your own machine. GitHub Pages replays the saved traces. The run form needs the local server.

projects.title: Macro Analyst Agent
projects.summary: A local LLM agent for macro questions, with an evaluation harness and LoRA fine-tuning on an open-weight model. The repository link is pending, so this card is a placeholder.
projects.caveat: No measured results yet. Task scores, tool-call accuracy, and latency will be added here only after they are in the repository. Nothing on this card is an estimate.

projects.title: ATLAS
projects.summary: A local research terminal for World Bank country data, an OECD production network, and PyTorch forecasts. It runs on one machine: no hosted service and no credentials.
projects.caveat: Ridge regression beat the graph neural models on the 2022 test. On US growth, one GRU seed beat ridge and two did not, on 10 held-out years. This is not a tradable backtest.
